entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi... I think I need to make a return? I'm not sure. The website is a little confusing.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Charlie. I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number to start?
Yes, the name is Alex Smith, and the order number is... VF-8675309.

Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the AeroLite helmet purchased 54 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh, um, a preference, I guess. The color just isn't what I thought it would be. It looked different online. It's still in the original packaging, the box is unopened.
I understand. Getting the right color is important. You want to feel good in your gear, especially something critical for your safety like a new helmet.
Exactly. I'm just so overwhelmed with the rules. Can't you just help me? I don't know if it's too late.
Of course, Alex. Let me check the return eligibility for you right now... Okay, I have good news. Our policy for standard items allows for returns within 90 days of delivery.

Yes, you're at day 54, so you are well within the return window. Since the box is unopened, I can go ahead and process that for you immediately. I'm sending a return shipping label to the email we have on file. Do you still have access to that?
Oh, that's wonderful! Yes, I do. Thank you so much, Charlie. I was so worried.
You're very welcome, Alex. Once we receive the helmet, we'll issue a full refund. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
Glad I could help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
